title: A replacement PR keeps the earlier review record when main moves: the carry by tree and the `--fix-check` source gate accept a live tree equal to the record head's tree plus a conflict-free merge of main
why: Request (coordinator 20:14 CST Nov 14, from the consultant's relay 20:13; REWRITTEN in place 20:16 CST Nov 14 by the coordinator's 20:16 reversal; triage read no record or code). Case: a REPLACEMENT PR keeps the earlier review record when main moves. Red case: #3429's record at b0b2f3bbed read against #3435 head ffc085233a9e. Rulings own-846-a-clean-merge-main-no-verifier and own-847-a-line-19-same-exception cover a clean merge on the SAME PR only; the carry applies the same rule to a replacement's tree. Built so far: the carry by tree (#3388, step review-carries-by-tree) takes one source PR and a byte-identical tree. SCOPE: the carry and the `--fix-check` source gate only. The lane lint stays exact: it is not forgiven over a clean merge of main, even on one PR today, and no ruling covers widening it. No owner question: the coordinator withdrew it. Basis (coordinator's read, unverified by triage): decision pr-review-record line 78 (owner 2026-11-10 14:07 CST, "letting it survive a clean merge where batch ci sees the problem") and own-846-a. The coordinator asked a question a ruling answered and says its past-ruling Stop guard now covers that; its miss came before the guard ran. Overlap read by triage (titles only): review-carries-by-tree is done and covers an identical tree and one source PR, so this is a new step; kin replacement-pr-carries-review (ready) and review-carries-own-record-commits (doing).
